description: At the Brackwell pumpkin patch, Princess wears a brass collar that Ma Stonefield wants as proof the sow is gone.
intro: At the Brackwell pumpkin patch, Princess wears a brass collar that Ma Stonefield wants as proof the sow is gone.

p: Princess is a huge, prize-winning sow owned by the Brackwell family. She roams their pumpkin patch east of the Maclure homestead, and her appetite leads her into the Stonefield Farm’s crops. After losing valuable vegetables to the sow, Ma Stonefield seeks someone willing to slay her. Princess wears a brass band around her neck, and the collar proves she will not raid the Stonefield fields again.
